---
title: "Week Results"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
source("_data.R")
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

for (w in sort(unique(weekly_summary$week))) {
  cat(paste0("\n## Week ", w, "\n\n"))

  week_totals <- weekly_summary %>%
    filter(week == w) %>%
    arrange(desc(week_dollars)) %>%
    select(
      Participant        = user,
      Correct     = correct,
      Total       = total,
      `Base $`    = base_dollars,
      `Bonus $`   = bonus_dollars,
      `Missed $`  = missed_dollars,
      `Week Total`= week_dollars
    )

  print(kable(week_totals))
  cat("\n")

  week_detail <- results %>%
    filter(week == w, !is.na(correct_pick)) %>%
    mutate(pick_display = paste0(pick, ifelse(bonus, " (B)", ""))) %>%
    select(game_id, team_away, team_home, spread, correct_pick, user, pick_display) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(game_id, team_away, team_home, spread, correct_pick),
      names_from  = user,
      values_from = pick_display
    )

  # Ensure every participant has a column, even if they made no picks this week
  for (u in setdiff(all_users, names(week_detail))) {
    week_detail[[u]] <- NA_character_
  }

  week_detail <- week_detail %>%
    mutate(Game = paste(team_away, "at", team_home)) %>%
    select(Game, `Home Spread` = spread, `Correct Pick` = correct_pick, all_of(all_users))

  print(kable(week_detail, na = ""))
  cat("\n")
}
```
